title: TypeScript feature flag evaluation
context: Feature flags. With rollout p (0-100) a flag is on when bucket(`${key}:${userId}`) < p, where bucket is 0..99, so rollout 0 is off for everyone. Admin overrides per user win over rollout, but a flag with enabled=false is off for everyone, overrides included. Query-string overrides ("?ff=key:on") are honoured only when allowQueryOverrides is true (dev builds).
